title: Implement HTML5 Canvas Renderer Engine
description: Create a modular rendering engine that handles canvas scaling, high-DPI displays, clear cycles, and drawing primitives for game entities. Include unit tests for coordinate transformations and rendering state management.
acceptanceCriteria: Renderer correctly initializes and scales the canvas context
Clear and draw calls execute without runtime errors
reviewFeedback: The HTML5 Canvas Renderer Engine implementation and unit tests are clean, modular, immutable where appropriate, and thoroughly test initialization, high-DPI scaling, and rendering primitives.
